messages:
Jordan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on the outage. Dropping the list of contributors, owners, and next steps so we can track closure.
Priya: Can we get the RCA link and a timeline for mitigation? Folks asked in the meeting.
Sam: Draft RCA here: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-03-22-draft. Root cause: cache invalidation race + a router retry amplification under partial failure. Working on attaching traces.
Anika: I'll own short-term mitigation: implement hot-key rate-limits, add guard in router retry logic. Plan: patch by Thu EOD, canary Fri 09:00, global rollout Mon 02:00.
Marcus: Request: prioritize Dedicated and Private tenants for mitigations and any manual rollback support.
Jordan: Affirmed. We prioritize those customers; I'll handle exec comms and sign-off.
Lina: I'll prepare customer-facing templates for Dedicated/Private and general status updates. Ping me before sending.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03122 updated to MONITORING. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-03122
Sam: Adding debug artifact: failing query we used to reproduce: ```promql
sum(rate(http_request_errors_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (region)
```
Anika: Note: patch surfaced a flaky integration test; quarantining now to keep canary signal clean.
Marcus: Can someone add a dashboard card for hot-key retry spikes? I can own it if eng-telemetry approves.
Priya: I'll run a 30m SLO sync Wed 10am with eng-sre, platform, and product. Deliverable: recommendation doc on whether to tighten latency SLOs or add compensating controls.
Jordan: Owners recap: Anika (mitigation), Sam (RCA & postmortem edits), Priya (SLO decision sync), Jordan (exec/customer comms), Lina (customer templates), Marcus (dashboard tile).
Sam: Targeting RCA close next Tue once canary verification is done.
Anika: Patch in PR, reviewers pinged. Will post the rollout checklist in #eng-runtime when PR merges.
Lina: I'll queue the Dedicated customer note for review; expect draft by tomorrow AM.
Jordan: Thanks all. If anyone else needs to be added as an owner, reply here. Let's get the action items into the sprint and mark them done as we go. :thumbsup:
